message: The user clarified that the line 251 template transform should not fail; execution proceeded as a direct repair request.

src/extension.js line 251 contains two simple template identifiers, dir and filePath. The transform guard rejected all template expressions without distinguishing safe identifier bindings from complex expressions.

Updated migration-source-transform.js to accept simple template identifiers, pass them as catalog.format arguments, retain the parser-required error for complex expressions, and choose the temporary variable within the enclosing block.

Modified build/mdl-language-app/services/migration-source-transform.js and build/mdl-language-app/tests/migration-source-transform.test.js for this repair. Existing src/extension.js and canonical catalog modifications were not changed.

The focused transform suite passed 5 of 5. Exact source-line evaluation returned catalog.format with dir and filePath plus logger.info(null, tMessage); // Debug only. Language Maintenance passed 80 of 80, Locale Maintenance passed 35 of 35, and scoped diff check passed.

The packaged Windows-control runtime failed with OS error 3. The first isolated Electron background launch did not start and its yielded command was terminated; a second exact launch succeeded and exposed the diagnostic endpoint.

The isolated Electron Add Record preview for src/extension.js line 251 displayed the expected two transformed lines, no parser-binding error, and a clean draft. Apply, Replace, Save, and Revert were not invoked; the app and diagnostic listener closed.
Simple template identifier substitutions now transform successfully at extension.js line 251, complex expressions remain guarded, and automated plus live validation passed.
